rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
compound object of knowing; gūḍha (hidden) + sadbhāva (true-nature)
state that arises as the result
main verb indicating the emergence of omniscience

items.question: What realization brings about the arising of omniscience?
premises: There is a hidden true nature to be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a decisive act.
Omniscience arises as a consequence of this knowing.
items.inference: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
